claim: FDALabel is an external FDA resource for full-text search across human prescription, biological, over-the-counter, and other drug labeling documents.
future_grounding_route: Specific DMT label facts can be queued as external-verifiable only after a named label version is downloaded, hashed, and compared against project-defined drug-mechanism fields.
project_use: Regulatory drug-label source for future MS DMT mechanism, indication, safety, and label-version context.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Regulatory drug-label text and labeling metadata for approved medicines, including possible MS DMT label context.
why_unverifiable: Drug labels and FDA database contents are external regulatory records; the project must acquire and version specific labels before using any label claim.
